passages.text:
[opaque block]
Lina:
As per my message on Signal, we saw this report today.
Civil Georgia | Meta Removes Russian-Origin Accounts, Pages Targeting Protesters of Foreign Agents Law
I don't know if the Mission has direct contact with Meta, but their Content & Product Policy Manager,
Misinformation, Mike Bradow is a friend/contact of mine and was worked for USAID for 10 years-both in Central Asia
and in OTI.
He could be a good contact for the mission, or at least put you in touch with the right people, particularly in the lead-
up to the elections.
Mike Bradow | LinkedIn Content & Product Policy Manager, Misinformation
Policy Lead for Fact-Checked Misinformation, coordinating a global team that manages product policies, enforcement,
and operational guidelines for Meta's industry-leading fact-checking program.
